easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, giving Weftstalker Ardent the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Imagecrafter, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
